paragraphs.text:
You’re in section-N, at the bottom of the stairs. Total the number 
of hours that you’ve been in the pyramid. If more than five, go to 
354. If less, there’s a shaft to the east, with handholds, leading to 
358; or, to the west, there are stairs returning you to 398.
(354, 358, 398)
